intended_use: Coding of open-text occupation and industry responses to ISCO-08 and ISIC Rev. 4 for the organization's surveys, with a confidence per code and human review of the routed share.
out_of_scope_use: Any task on respondents' free text other than coding; any use without the confidence threshold and the re-coded sample.
training_data: Fine-tuned on 48,000 coder-labelled responses from the organization's 2023 to 2025 labour force surveys; no external data; records never left the organization.
known_limitations: Local occupations absent from the index; lower accuracy on Swahili responses (0.87 at 4 digits).
hardware: Runs on one 24 GB GPU at 4-bit quantization or on CPU for batch jobs.
